Alphabet Q1 2026 Analysis

No contemporaneous preview was available as of the cutoff date (April 29, 2026). This analysis is based solely on the official earnings release.

Actual results:
- Revenue: $109.9B, +22% YoY (+19% constant currency), the 11th consecutive quarter of double-digit growth.
- Net income: $62.6B, +81%; diluted EPS: $5.11, +82%.
- Operating income: $39.7B, +30%; operating margin 36.1%, up ~2pp.

Segment results:
- Google Services revenue $89.6B, +16%. Search & other $60.4B (+19%), YouTube ads $9.9B (+11%), Google Network $7.0B (-4%), subscriptions/platforms/devices $12.4B (+19%). Segment operating income $40.6B, margin 45.3%.
- Google Cloud revenue $20.0B, +63% (accelerating). Segment operating income $6.6B, up from $2.2B; margin 32.9% vs 17.8%.
- Other Bets revenue $0.4B (-9%), operating loss deepened to -$2.1B.
- Alphabet-level activities (shared AI R&D) loss widened to -$5.4B from -$3.0B.

Other financial items:
- Other income net: +$37.7B, mainly unrealized gains on non-marketable equity securities.
- Issued $31.1B senior unsecured notes.
- Quarterly dividend raised 5% to $0.22.

CEO commentary:
- AI experiences driving search usage and record queries; Cloud backlog nearly doubled QoQ to >$460B; paid subscriptions reached 350M; Gemini Enterprise paid MAU +40% QoQ; Waymo >500k fully autonomous rides per week; Gemini API processes >16B tokens per minute via direct API, +60% QoQ.

Comparison with expectations:
- No contemporaneous preview or explicit Q2 2026 guidance in the release; no reliable consensus data in the source.

Profit/cash notes:
- Margin expansion mainly from Cloud operating margin improvement and Services margin gain, partly offset by higher Alphabet-level AI R&D losses.
- Debt issuance and dividend increase noted.

Next-quarter watch:
- Sustainability of AI-driven search growth; Cloud backlog conversion and margins; AI R&D/capex impact on operating margin; Google Network decline; Other Bets losses.
reader_questions: The $460B backlog figure is attributed to Google Cloud in the CEO quote, but the release does not define its scope or accounting treatment. If readers interpret it as remaining performance obligations (RPO), expectations of revenue conversion may be overstated.

The $37.7B other income is mostly unrealized gains on non-marketable equity securities. Since these are non-cash and non-recurring, using net income growth of 81% as a gauge of operating performance could mislead.
Alphabet-level activities losses grew to -$5.4B from -$3.0B, flagged as shared AI R&D. If these expenses and related capex keep rising, can the 36.1% operating margin hold in coming quarters?
fact_checks: Confirmed release date 2026-04-29 and fiscal quarter Q1 ended March 31, 2026.
Verified all financial figures are in USD millions unless noted; constant currency is non-GAAP.
Calculated YoY growth for total revenue, segments, operating income, net income, EPS; figures match press release.
Confirmed segment operating results include Google Services, Google Cloud, Other Bets, Alphabet-level activities.
Confirmed no contemporaneous preview was available in the provided source set.
Confirmed the press release contains no explicit Q2 2026 guidance or market consensus data.
